# T-201, R-U2: anonymous readonly interface methods `interface{ const Get() int }`.
# The contract package exports Use(x interface{ const Get() int }) int (P0.MGet
# shape), Holder with Inner Namer (named FInner indirection via existing I.M)
# and Anon interface{ const Get() int } (FAnon.MGet shape), NewNamer() Namer
# (R0 named via existing I.M) and NewAnon() interface{ const Get() int }
# (R0.MGet shape), Alias = Namer and AnonAlias = interface{ const Get() int }
# (alias RHS transparent, same paths as underlying), and AllNamed[T Namer]
# generic with a named qualified constraint (expressible today; roots skip
# emission like existing generics but constraints enter the affected closure
# via subst, so the bound iface still rebuilds readonly). An
# anonymous-constraint generic All[T interface{ const Get() int }] would be
# the G0.MGet shape (type G[T] same G0; generic method recv params via H)
# but is documented optional only: the parser may not accept const in
# constraint position, so the core P0/R0/F shapes never block on it.
# Every implementer must be provably readonly (independent runtime truth):
# pure value getters are accepted and run to anon-ok / go-anon-ok; an
# other-package mutating value getter (slice write through the receiver) is
# rejected with the approved call-site code const_view_mutation, and an
# ordinary Go importer mutator is likewise rejected. No satisfaction or
# fingerprint wire text is pinned here (facts owner owns it); only the
# const_view_mutation code is asserted. Modules stay homogeneous: w/l is
# all-.lgo, w/g is all-.go via go.work, neg is all-.lgo, gneg is all-.go
# with a replace to w/l. Case 1 builds and runs first so a later red is a
# semantic proof, never a syntax failure.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# Case 1: syntax works and pure getters are accepted through every shape.
# Independent runtime truth: Run returns anon-ok / go-anon-ok only when
# each qualified call observes the expected pure value.
cd w
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/anon$GOEXE ./l/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/anon$GOEXE
stdout '^anon-ok$'
logos build -o $WORK/bin/goanon$GOEXE ./g/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/goanon$GOEXE
stdout '^go-anon-ok$'
cd ..

# Case 2: other-package (other than c) mutating value getters rejected.
# Each attack package defines its Mut locally so the deferred package-end
# proof reports with the approved code; only the code is pinned.
cd neg
! logos build ./anon
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
! logos build ./holder
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
! logos build ./retanon
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
! logos build ./alias
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
! logos build ./generic
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
cd ..

# Case 3: ordinary Go importer mutator rejected through the anonymous shape.
cd gneg
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
cd ..

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

-- w/l/c/c.lgo --
package c

type Namer interface {
	const Get() int
}

func Use(x interface{ const Get() int }) int {
	return x.Get()
}

type Holder struct {
	Inner Namer
	Anon  interface{ const Get() int }
}

func NewNamer(n Namer) Namer {
	return n
}

func NewAnon(n interface{ const Get() int }) interface{ const Get() int } {
	return n
}

type Alias = Namer

type AnonAlias = interface{ const Get() int }

func AllNamed[T Namer](x T) int {
	return x.Get()
}

// Optional G0.MGet shape if the parser accepts const in constraint
// position (guarded, never blocking the core P0/R0/F shapes):
// func All[T interface{ const Get() int }](x T) int {
// 	return x.Get()
// }

-- w/l/p/p.lgo --
package p

import "example.com/l/c"

type Pure struct {
	V int
}

func (p Pure) Get() int {
	return p.V
}

func MakePure(v int) Pure {
	return Pure{V: v}
}

func MakePureNamer(v int) c.Namer {
	return MakePure(v)
}

func MakePureAnon(v int) c.AnonAlias {
	return MakePure(v)
}

type Mut struct {
	S []int
}

func (m Mut) Get() int {
	m.S[0] = 1
	return m.S[0]
}

func MakeMut(v int) Mut {
	return Mut{S: []int{v}}
}

-- w/l/q/q.lgo --
package q

import (
	"example.com/l/c"
	"example.com/l/p"
)

func ViaAnon(x interface{ const Get() int }) int {
	return x.Get()
}

func ViaHolder(h c.Holder) int {
	return h.Inner.Get() + h.Anon.Get()
}

func ViaReturnNamer(n c.Namer) int {
	return c.NewNamer(n).Get()
}

func ViaReturnAnon(x interface{ const Get() int }) int {
	return c.NewAnon(x).Get()
}

func ViaAlias(a c.Alias) int {
	return a.Get()
}

func ViaAnonAlias(a c.AnonAlias) int {
	return a.Get()
}

func ViaGeneric[T c.Namer](x T) int {
	return x.Get()
}

func ViaAllNamed(x p.Pure) int {
	return c.AllNamed(x)
}

func Run() string {
	pure := p.MakePure(7)
	if c.Use(pure) != 7 {
		return "bad-use"
	}
	if ViaAnon(pure) != 7 {
		return "bad-viaanon"
	}
	h := c.Holder{Inner: pure, Anon: pure}
	if ViaHolder(h) != 14 {
		return "bad-holder"
	}
	if ViaReturnNamer(pure) != 7 {
		return "bad-retnamer"
	}
	if ViaReturnAnon(pure) != 7 {
		return "bad-retanon"
	}
	if c.NewNamer(pure).Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-newnamer"
	}
	if c.NewAnon(pure).Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-newanon"
	}
	var a c.Alias = pure
	if ViaAlias(a) != 7 {
		return "bad-alias"
	}
	var aa c.AnonAlias = pure
	if ViaAnonAlias(aa) != 7 {
		return "bad-anonalias"
	}
	if p.MakePureNamer(7).Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-makenamer"
	}
	if p.MakePureAnon(7).Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-makeanon"
	}
	if ViaGeneric(pure) != 7 {
		return "bad-generic"
	}
	if ViaAllNamed(pure) != 7 {
		return "bad-allnamed"
	}
	if c.AllNamed(pure) != 7 {
		return "bad-allnamed-direct"
	}
	return "anon-ok"
}

-- w/l/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/l/q"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(q.Run())
}

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- w/g/qq/qq.go --
package qq

import (
	"example.com/l/c"
	"example.com/l/p"
)

type G int

func (g G) Get() int { return int(g) }

func Run() string {
	pure := p.MakePure(7)
	var plain interface{ Get() int } = pure
	if plain.Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-plain"
	}
	var n c.Namer = pure
	if n.Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-namer"
	}
	if c.NewNamer(pure).Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-newnamer"
	}
	if c.Use(pure) != 7 {
		return "bad-use"
	}
	if c.Use(G(7)) != 7 {
		return "bad-g"
	}
	var m c.Namer = G(7)
	if m.Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-gnamer"
	}
	if c.NewNamer(G(7)).Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-gnew"
	}
	h := c.Holder{Inner: pure, Anon: pure}
	if h.Inner.Get()+h.Anon.Get() != 14 {
		return "bad-holder"
	}
	hg := c.Holder{Inner: G(7), Anon: G(7)}
	if hg.Inner.Get()+hg.Anon.Get() != 14 {
		return "bad-gholder"
	}
	var a c.Alias = pure
	if a.Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-alias"
	}
	var ag c.Alias = G(7)
	if ag.Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-galias"
	}
	return "go-anon-ok"
}

-- w/g/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/g/qq"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(qq.Run()) }

-- neg/c/c.lgo --
package c

type Namer interface {
	const Get() int
}

func Use(x interface{ const Get() int }) int {
	return x.Get()
}

type Holder struct {
	Inner Namer
	Anon  interface{ const Get() int }
}

func NewNamer(n Namer) Namer {
	return n
}

func NewAnon(n interface{ const Get() int }) interface{ const Get() int } {
	return n
}

type Alias = Namer

type AnonAlias = interface{ const Get() int }

func AllNamed[T Namer](x T) int {
	return x.Get()
}

// Optional G0.MGet shape if the parser accepts const in constraint
// position (guarded, never blocking the core P0/R0/F shapes):
// func All[T interface{ const Get() int }](x T) int {
// 	return x.Get()
// }

-- neg/anon/anon.lgo --
package anon

import "example.com/neg/c"

type Mut struct {
	S []int
}

func (m Mut) Get() int {
	m.S[0] = 1
	return m.S[0]
}

func Attack() int {
	return c.Use(Mut{S: []int{1}})
}

-- neg/holder/holder.lgo --
package holder

import "example.com/neg/c"

type Pure struct {
	V int
}

func (p Pure) Get() int {
	return p.V
}

type Mut struct {
	S []int
}

func (m Mut) Get() int {
	m.S[0] = 1
	return m.S[0]
}

func Attack() int {
	h := c.Holder{Inner: Pure{V: 1}, Anon: Mut{S: []int{1}}}
	return h.Inner.Get() + h.Anon.Get()
}

-- neg/retanon/retanon.lgo --
package retanon

import "example.com/neg/c"

type Mut struct {
	S []int
}

func (m Mut) Get() int {
	m.S[0] = 1
	return m.S[0]
}

func Attack() int {
	return c.NewAnon(Mut{S: []int{1}}).Get()
}

-- neg/alias/alias.lgo --
package alias

import "example.com/neg/c"

type Mut struct {
	S []int
}

func (m Mut) Get() int {
	m.S[0] = 1
	return m.S[0]
}

func Attack() int {
	var a c.AnonAlias = Mut{S: []int{1}}
	return a.Get()
}

-- neg/generic/generic.lgo --
package generic

import "example.com/neg/c"

type Mut struct {
	S []int
}

func (m Mut) Get() int {
	m.S[0] = 1
	return m.S[0]
}

func Attack() int {
	return c.AllNamed(Mut{S: []int{1}})
}

-- gneg/go.mod --
module example.com/gneg

go 1.27

require example.com/l v0.0.0

replace example.com/l => ../w/l

-- gneg/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/l/c"

type Mut struct {
	S []int
}

func (m Mut) Get() int {
	m.S[0] = 1
	return m.S[0]
}

func main() {
	println(c.Use(Mut{S: []int{1}}))
}
